title: Notification regarding Court sitting of Special Division Bench of Hon'ble The Chief Justice & Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma on 25/09/2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma on 25-08-2026 at 2:00 pm only for hearing PIL
4 Ors.] and Single Bench matters of Hon’ble The Chief Justice to be listed on 25-08-2026

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 24th August, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ It is informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that there will be a Special Division Bench of Hon’ble The Chief Justice and
Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma on 25-08-2026 at 2:00 pm only for hearing PIL
No. 14 at 2026 \The Kangleipak Students Association KSA and Anr. Vs. Union Of India and
4 Ors.] and Single Bench matters of Hon’ble The Chief Justice to be listed on 25-08-2026
will be taken up on the same day before the Single Bench of Hon’ble Mr. Justice A.
Guneshwar Sharma for fixing dates, extension of interim orders as well as for taking up
urgent matters.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(MONALISA MAIBAM)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
E.dt. N,. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ / 9 gZ g Imphal, the 24th August, 2026
